verdict.rationale: LobeHub documents Scheduled Tasks ("Schedule tasks and let Agents handle the rest" and a Scheduled Task usage doc), so agents can act automatically on a time-based trigger. Nothing in the evidence shows user-defined event→action rules (e.g., on new message, file change, or external event). Messenger/IM Gateway integrations are chat surfaces, not rule triggers. missing for 10: user-defined event-based trigger rules, documented event types/conditions, rule configuration docs, any hands-on corroboration.
